title: Compact control overlap with sticky headers on small viewports + chart legend clipping in Firefox: cross-platform QA & remediation plan
creator: Evan Patel
description: Multiple regressions surfaced during exploratory QA on the compact mode and chart components: (1) compact action controls (buttons/toggles) overlap or are clipped under sticky table headers at narrow widths (iOS Safari and Chrome Android), and (2) legend items in SVG-based charts get visually clipped or truncated in Firefox when density tokens are scaled down. This ticket scopes triage, reproducible test cases, design token adjustments, and a remediation plan with engineering handoff and verification criteria.
steps_to_reproduce: Open Dashboard > Dataset Table in compact mode on a device with viewport width <= 420px (iPhone SE emulation).
Scroll the table; observe sticky header behavior. Note any compact controls (row action buttons, row checkbox) that visually overlap with the header or lose tappable area.

Switch to Firefox Desktop and open Chart Explorer > Multi-series area chart with legend and compact density token applied. Resize width to 800px and reduce scale to compact. Observe legend entries clipping/truncation and stacked label wrap issues.
Repeat in Safari iOS and Chrome Android to confirm platform-specific variations and pointer/touch hitbox regressions.
acceptance_criteria: Compact controls no longer overlap or clip under sticky headers at mobile breakpoints; visual spacing adheres to token spec and touch target minimums (44px).
Chart legends render without clipping in Firefox across density scales; text wraps or truncates per spec with ellipsis when necessary and tooltip/accessibility provided for full text.
Updated design tokens (spacing, z-index, transform/perspective) documented in UI Kit token page and referenced in component stories.
Automated visual regression tests added for the two critical scenarios and included in CI.
Engineering PR(s) approved and merged; QA signoff performed on physical device (iOS 16/17, Chrome Android, Firefox Desktop) and recorded in this ticket.
comments: 2025-02-11 — Evan Patel: Initial exploratory notes uploaded. Found two distinct failure modes: hitbox shrinkage due to negative margin token + transform on sticky header; legend clipping appears tied to SVG viewBox + CSS overflow in Firefox. Added screenshots.

2025-02-13 — Maya Chen: Prioritized this as P1 for the cycle. Proposed short-term mitigation: increase compact control top padding and add explicit z-index for sticky headers. Long-term: audit density token interactions with transforms. Assigned ENG-22310 for investigation.

2025-02-14 — Leo Martin (Eng): Investigation complete. Root cause for overlap: .compact-row uses translateY(-2px) to tighten density; this interacts with position:sticky and causes subpixel rounding differences on mobile browsers. For charts, Firefox paints clipped legend because the foreignObject fallback was used; switching to pure SVG text + measured bbox fixes rendering. Drafted a patch (PR linked).

2025-02-20 — Design review: PM (Amira Singh) reviewed patch; suggested increase to touch target minimum of 44px and add visible focus ring in compact mode for keyboard users. Design updated tokens and added notes to token docs: spacing.compact.rowPadding = 6px, tokens.zIndex.stickyHeader = 800.
2025-02-25 — Eng PR merged for chart legend fix (ui-kit#4873). Visual regression tests added for chart legend in Firefox against baseline. Follow-up: ENG-22745 to backfill additional chart patterns.

2025-03-02 — QA (Ravi Kumar): Verified fixed chart rendering in Firefox Desktop and Nightly. Compact control overlap mitigated in Chrome Android; still seeing minor clipping on iOS 16 Safari when dynamic font sizes are increased—adding a follow-up sub-issue.

2025-03-04 — Maya Chen: Updated acceptance criteria to require physical device verification and added a follow-up ticket DES-91311 for iOS dynamic type edgecases. Marking this ticket close-to-resolution pending final QA signoff.
